note: THE COMMITTED ROSTER the creature generator measures its full-drawing collisions over (docs/design/FLOOR.md § 10.4's collision bullet, card#11046). Every key states its source: a fixture's seat, or a seat the fleet is known to run, read from a record that can be cited. No key is invented to make a measurement pass. It was the population the species salt was checked against until card#12443: a seat's body is now allocated by the server over the live fleet (docs/design/FLEET-STATE.md § 6.13), the salt (`SPECIES_FIELD`) is only that allocation's preference order, and it is never searched again. Grow it as the fleet grows.
